$comment: Worker bookkeeping tables in public (ADR-0013 §4; data-model §3.5 as added by TASK-039): job_executions, the idempotency ledger of job effects (REQ-PLAT-014). SYSTEM: no org_id and no RLS (a scheduled job has no organisation; a tenant job's organisation comes from platform.job_context, TASK-047). Owner module worker: eslint SYSTEM_MODEL_OWNERS maps it to apps/worker/src/platform/**. Grants (prisma/sql/grants.manifest): platform_app SELECT, INSERT; never UPDATE (a row is written once, in the effect's transaction) and never DELETE until a housekeeping purge with its retention predicate is specified. stdColumns: the full standard-column set, written by a runtime role, so the standard-columns guard trigger is rendered.
